title: Open and Use the Tipping Station Screen on the Tipper HMI
summary: Navigate the Tipper HMI to the “Tipping Station” screen to view bag completion counts, error information, and task duration metrics for the tipping station.
when_to_use: Use when you need to monitor tipping station performance by checking bag completion counts, error information, and how long tasks take on the Tipper HMI.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the HMI navigation steps to open the “Tipping Station” screen and verify the displayed metrics.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (allowed access surface: tipper_hmi)
HMI navigation controls: SMALLS button, ACB drop-down, ACB1 - AMT TT option, tipper button on the right side of the screen

visual_references.description: Figure 4-7: Tipping Station Screen (shows bag completion count, error indicators/counts, and task duration metrics).

steps.title: Press the SMALLS button on the Tipper HMI
steps.purpose: Start navigation to the ACB-related screens on the Tipper HMI.
steps.instruction: On the Tipper HMI, press the SMALLS button.
steps.expected_result: The SMALLS drop-down menu is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The SMALLS drop-down menu appears and is selectable.
steps.failure_condition: The SMALLS drop-down menu does not appear or cannot be selected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To access this information, press SMALLS then select "ACB" from the drop-down menu.

steps.title: Select ACB from the SMALLS drop-down menu
steps.purpose: Choose the ACB category to reach the correct ACB instance.
steps.expected_result: The options list updates to show ACB options.
steps.healthy_condition: “ACB” is selected and the next options list is available.
steps.failure_condition: “ACB” is not selectable or selecting it does not advance to the ACB options list.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To access this information, press SMALLS then select "ACB" from the drop-down menu.

steps.title: Select ACB1 - AMT TT from the options list
steps.purpose: Select the specific ACB instance required to open the Tipping Station screen.
steps.instruction: From the options list, select "ACB1 - AMT TT".
steps.expected_result: The system is set to the “ACB1 - AMT TT” context so the tipper button can open the Tipping Station screen.
steps.healthy_condition: “ACB1 - AMT TT” is selected and the screen is ready for the next action (pressing the tipper button).
steps.failure_condition: “ACB1 - AMT TT” is not present/selectable or selection does not prepare the screen for the tipper button action.

actions.label: Select ACB1 - AMT TT
actions.exact_action: select "ACB1 - AMT TT" from the options

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Then select "ACB1 - AMT TT" from the options.

steps.title: Press the tipper button on the right side of the screen
steps.purpose: Open the “Tipping Station” screen for the selected ACB instance.
steps.instruction: Press the tipper button on the right side of the screen.
steps.failure_condition: The “Tipping Station” screen does not appear after selecting “ACB1 - AMT TT” and pressing the tipper button.

actions.label: Open Tipping Station screen
actions.exact_action: press the tipper button on the right side of the screen

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Tipping Station” screen does not appear after selecting "ACB1 - AMT TT" and pressing the tipper button, stop and escalate to support/site IT to restore HMI navigation or access.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Then press the tipper button on the right side of the screen. The "Tipping Station" screen provides information on how many bags are completed, errors, and how long tasks take.

steps.title: Verify bag completion, errors, and task duration metrics on the Tipping Station screen
steps.purpose: Confirm the screen is functioning and capture the key operational metrics it provides.
steps.instruction: Verify the “Tipping Station” screen is displayed and check that it shows: (1) how many bags are completed, (2) errors, and (3) how long tasks take.
steps.expected_result: The “Tipping Station” screen displays bag completion information, error information, and task duration/timers.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see values/indicators for: bag completion count, error information, and task duration metrics on the “Tipping Station” screen.
steps.failure_condition: The “Tipping Station” screen is missing one or more of the expected metric areas (bag completion, errors, task duration) or the screen does not display the expected information.

actions.label: Check metrics
actions.exact_action: check that it shows how many bags are completed, errors, and how long tasks take

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The "Tipping Station" screen provides information on how many bags are completed, errors, and how long tasks take.

success_criteria: The “Tipping Station” screen opens successfully on the Tipper HMI.
The screen displays bag completion information, error information, and task duration metrics.
failure_conditions: “Tipping Station” screen does not appear after selecting “ACB1 - AMT TT” and pressing the tipper button.
“Tipping Station” screen appears but does not show bag completion, errors, and task duration metrics.
escalation_guidance: If the “Tipping Station” screen does not appear after selecting "ACB1 - AMT TT" and pressing the tipper button, stop and escalate to support/site IT to restore HMI navigation or access.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: To access this information, press SMALLS then select "ACB" from the drop-down menu. Then select "ACB1 - AMT TT" from the options. Then press the tipper button on the right side of the screen. The "Tipping Station" screen provides information on how many bags are completed, errors, and how long tasks take.
